title.narrative: Activity under preparation Support to the assessment of priority countries and impact of CBRN risk mitigation external actions

description.narrative: Contract related to: Support to the assessment of priority countries and impact of CBRN risk mitigation external actions - The actions envisaged under the thematic area ¿Global, transregional and emerging threats¿ of the NDICI Global Europe-Thematic Programme on Peace, Stability and Conflict Prevention aim at building the capacities and preparedness of the EU and its partners countries in the field of security. Within this framework, the nineteenth edition of the Expert Support Facility (ESF) will continue to provide direct support to the Union¿s external policies by increasing the efficiency of the Union¿s actions in this area of intervention. Expert Support Facility may comprise ad hoc intervention when unexpected events jeopardise the success of actions foreseen under this area of intervention, which may include the transfer of know-how, the exchange of information and best practices (including the use and development of methodologies and/or knowledge products), risk/threat assessment, research and analysis, training and service delivery, as well as financial and technical assistance for security capacity -building etc. To facilitate all of the above, the EU and its partners, including third countries, should have access to expertise to aid in identifying, planning, and executing capacity-building activities.
